title: Memento mori
src: Seneca, On the Shortness of Life
idea: Your time is limited and its end is uncertain. Remembering that sharpens what you choose to do with it.
apply: Pick one thing from your someday list and put a date on it this week.
remind: Time is limited. Do the important thing this week.
who: Sofia, who keeps postponing a visit to her parents.

scenes.nar: Sofia keeps a someday list. Visit her parents, learn the piano, write the book. Someday always feels far away.

scenes.sub: About eighty years. Time is not endless.
scenes.nar: An eighty year life is only about four thousand weeks. Time feels endless, but it is not.
So she remembers that her time is limited, and moves items from someday to this week. A call tonight, a train booked, a first lesson.
The call lasts forty minutes, and her father is thrilled. Remembering that time ends helped her use it.
